title: Decadent Thai Epoisses Gratin
description: A rich and creamy Thai-inspired dish featuring the pungent flavors of epoisses, topped with a crispy dutch delicacy.
instructions: Caramelize the onions by cooking them over low heat for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a separate pan, combine the Thai red curry paste and Dutch cream. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the epoisses cheese and chocolate to the cream mixture, stirring until melted and smooth.
Stir in the caramelized onions and season with salt and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with a layer of grated dutch delicacy.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
